subject: Web Development
title: The Render Tree
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Render Tree.

hook.text: The DOM holds structure. CSS holds style. Neither alone tells the browser what to paint.

buildup.text: The browser merges both into a render tree that contains only visible elements.

discovery.text: Hidden elements and head tags are excluded. Only what you see gets into the render tree.

twist.text: An element with display:none vanishes from the render tree entirely — it's truly invisible.

climax.text: The render tree is the browser's blueprint for painting pixels on your screen.

punchline.text: Only visible things get to be painted.

quiz.question: What does the render tree exclude?
